name: Restrained
text: A creature who is restrained has speed 0, can’t use the Stand Up maneuver, and can’t be force moved. A restrained creature takes a bane on ability rolls and on Might and Agility tests, and abilities used against them gain an edge.
If a creature teleports while restrained, that condition ends.
